snippet.title: Beyond Astra - Exclusive Gameplay Trailer 2 | Galaxies Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Get a brand new look at this incredible real-time 4X sci-fi grand strategy game. Expand your own civilization, explore captivating and mysterious planets and star clusters, interact with your citizens and other life forms and shape your destiny through nearly infinite possibilities.
